dataVersion: EltonTraits 1.0; metadata latest update August 2013; paper July 2014
recordCountBoundary: Parsed files have 9995 bird and 5403 mammal rows, including respectively 2 and 3 unnamed trailing rows. Named records are 9993 and 5400; they are historical data records, not the pinned COL denominator.
textDecoding: cp1252 for TSV reading: original bytes include 0x92 despite archive ASCII description. Raw bytes retained losslessly, not normalized.
selection: Unique exact accepted COL name in same class/family; no commented avian split records; >=2 eligible ecological field groups. Birds: diet A/B and stratum SpecLevel=1, with complete original source labels. Mammals: diet/activity ABC or strata A with metadata attribution. ABC can retain specific congeneric inference.
